note: CT burden multiples of the nominal burden (A: 1 ohm, B: 2.5 ohm) for the v5 generators. Chosen from the CT deviation on a 3-phase external fault (burden_sweep_v5_console.txt, probe_burden_sweep_v5.m) BEFORE any dataset was generated or any model trained: normal = tolerance on the nominal burden; stress = range in which the CT output deviates more than ~10 % in the first cycles; ood = beyond the stress range (OOD block 3).
